dilemmes.d1: You win 10 million on the lottery together
dilemmes.d1_mais: you can never set foot in a restaurant again for the rest of your life
dilemmes.d2: You never have to work again for the rest of your life
dilemmes.d2_mais: you both have to live in the town you least want to live in
dilemmes.d3: You are given your dream house, fully paid for
dilemmes.d3_mais: it is four hours' drive from everyone you love
dilemmes.d4: Your groceries are free for life
dilemmes.d4_mais: someone else fills the trolley and you choose nothing
dilemmes.d5: You receive €5,000 a month for doing nothing
dilemmes.d5_mais: you have to wear the same outfit every day for ten years
dilemmes.d6: All your holidays are paid for over the next twenty years
dilemmes.d6_mais: you have to travel with another couple, picked at random, that you cannot choose
dilemmes.d7: You never pay rent or a mortgage again
dilemmes.d7_mais: your home is twenty-five square metres, forever
dilemmes.d8: Your car is replaced by the car of your dreams
dilemmes.d8_mais: one of you will never be allowed to drive it
dilemmes.d9: A stranger pays for your whole wedding, with no budget limit
dilemmes.d9_mais: they get to choose the guest list
dilemmes.d10: You become homeowners without borrowing a single penny
dilemmes.d10_mais: you can never move house, whatever happens
dilemmes.d11: You go on holiday to your dream destination
dilemmes.d11_mais: your flight is cancelled and the journey ends up taking four days
dilemmes.d12: You travel the world for a year, all expenses paid
dilemmes.d12_mais: you cannot take a single photo, a single video, nothing
dilemmes.d13: You get one romantic weekend away every month, for life
dilemmes.d13_mais: it is always the same weekend, in the same place
dilemmes.d14: You are given a five-star hotel for your next trip
dilemmes.d14_mais: you have to share the suite with your in-laws
dilemmes.d15: You fly first class for free for the rest of your life
dilemmes.d15_mais: you can never book two seats next to each other
dilemmes.d16: You spend three months on a paradise island
dilemmes.d16_mais: there is no signal, no internet, no phone
dilemmes.d17: You visit every country in the world
dilemmes.d17_mais: you never stay longer than twenty-four hours in any of them
dilemmes.d18: You set off on a month-long road trip in a fully fitted van
dilemmes.d18_mais: the air conditioning is broken and it is the middle of August
dilemmes.d19: Someone cleans your home every single day, for free
dilemmes.d19_mais: that person is allowed to move and reorganise your things however they like
dilemmes.d20: You never wash up again for the rest of your life
dilemmes.d20_mais: you have to cook every meal, every day, without exception
dilemmes.d21: Your bed becomes the most comfortable bed in the world
dilemmes.d21_mais: one of you has to get up at five every morning
dilemmes.d22: You have a huge bathtub with a sea view
dilemmes.d23: You never pay for electricity or heating again
dilemmes.d23_mais: you can never go above eighteen degrees at home
dilemmes.d24: Your flat doubles in size overnight
dilemmes.d24_mais: the neighbours upstairs throw a party every Saturday night
dilemmes.d25: You never tidy anything again, everything puts itself away
dilemmes.d25_mais: you never find anything first time
dilemmes.d26: Both sets of in-laws are the best in the world and adore you
dilemmes.d26_mais: you have to pay for the meal every single time you see them
dilemmes.d27: Your in-laws live five minutes away on foot
dilemmes.d27_mais: they drop in unannounced at least twice a week
dilemmes.d28: Your friends invite you everywhere, all the time
dilemmes.d28_mais: you always have to be the last to leave and help them tidy up
dilemmes.d29: You never have to sit through a painful Christmas again
dilemmes.d29_mais: you never see half of your family again
dilemmes.d30: Your best friend moves into the flat next door
dilemmes.d30_mais: they have a key to your place and they use it
dilemmes.d31: You are invited to every wedding in your circle, all expenses paid
dilemmes.d31_mais: you have to give a speech at each one
dilemmes.d32: Your mother-in-law becomes your greatest ally
dilemmes.d32_mais: she gives her opinion on your relationship every week, unprompted
dilemmes.d33: A top chef cooks at your place every evening
dilemmes.d33_mais: you never get to choose the menu
dilemmes.d34: You can eat whatever you like without ever gaining a gram
dilemmes.d34_mais: you lose your taste for anything sweet, forever
dilemmes.d35: Your favourite dish becomes unlimited and free
dilemmes.d35_mais: you are not allowed to eat anything else at weekends
dilemmes.d36: You never have to do the food shopping again
dilemmes.d36_mais: you eat exactly the same thing as your partner, at every meal, for life
dilemmes.d37: You have a wine cellar stocked with the finest bottles
dilemmes.d37_mais: you may only open one a year
dilemmes.d38: Breakfast is served to you in bed every morning
dilemmes.d38_mais: it is served at six on the dot, Sundays included
dilemmes.d39: You stay together for the rest of your lives and share a passionate love
dilemmes.d39_mais: one of you will be away four months a year
dilemmes.d40: You both gain ten years of life
dilemmes.d40_mais: you spend them without ever being able to travel
dilemmes.d41: You get a three-day weekend for the rest of your life
dilemmes.d41_mais: you work nights the other four
dilemmes.d42_mais: you have to spend that retirement in the town where you were born
dilemmes.d43: One of you stops ageing physically from today
dilemmes.d44: You get two extra hours a day, just for the two of you
dilemmes.d44_mais: they fall between three and five in the morning
dilemmes.d45: You sleep just four hours a night and feel perfectly fine
dilemmes.d45_mais: you can never take a nap again
dilemmes.d46: You both land your dream job
dilemmes.d46_mais: you work in the same office, facing each other, all day long
dilemmes.d47_mais: you only come home at weekends
dilemmes.d48_mais: so does your partner, in the same room, with no partition
dilemmes.d49: You become your own boss and it works beautifully
dilemmes.d49_mais: you never take more than one week off in a row
dilemmes.d50_mais: you have to live directly above your workplace
dilemmes.d51: Your children are lovely, polite and sleep through every night
dilemmes.d52: A perfect nanny looks after your children whenever you want
dilemmes.d52_mais: she lives in your home permanently
dilemmes.d53: You have the family you always dreamed of
dilemmes.d53_mais: you all have to live under the same roof until the children turn thirty
dilemmes.d54: Your children succeed brilliantly at everything they try
dilemmes.d54_mais: they move to the other side of the world at eighteen
dilemmes.d55: You have a child exactly like you in every way
dilemmes.d55_mais: they also have every one of your flaws, only stronger
dilemmes.d56: Your battery never drops below ten per cent again
dilemmes.d56_mais: your partner sees everything you do on your screen
dilemmes.d57: You get unlimited internet anywhere in the world, for free
dilemmes.d57_mais: you are no longer allowed on social media
dilemmes.d58: You can erase one embarrassing memory from your relationship
dilemmes.d59: You always know exactly what your partner is thinking
dilemmes.d59_mais: they know exactly what you are thinking too
dilemmes.d60: Every photo of the two of you comes out perfectly, without exception
dilemmes.d60_mais: you may only keep ten a year
dilemmes.d61: You get back every message you have ever sent each other
dilemmes.d61_mais: they are published online for anyone to read
dilemmes.d62: Your partner declares their love for you every week
dilemmes.d62_mais: they do it in front of everyone, out loud, in public
dilemmes.d63_mais: you can never make up after an argument again either
dilemmes.d64: You have the most beautiful wedding night imaginable
dilemmes.d64_mais: you will not remember a single thing about it the next day
dilemmes.d65: You get the butterflies of the early days back for a whole year
dilemmes.d66: Your partner always guesses what would make you happy
dilemmes.d67: You receive a bunch of flowers every week, for life
dilemmes.d67_mais: you have to pay for it yourself
dilemmes.d68: You relive the day you met, exactly the same but better
dilemmes.d68_mais: you forget everything you have lived through since
dilemmes.d69: You get a movie kiss, in the rain, with the soundtrack
dilemmes.d69_mais: there is a camera and it goes out on television
dilemmes.d70: You are both in perfect physical shape until you are eighty
dilemmes.d70_mais: you have to do an hour of sport every day, without exception
dilemmes.d71_mais: your partner catches everything you should have caught
dilemmes.d72: Your hair looks perfect every single day
dilemmes.d72_mais: you can never change the style again
dilemmes.d73_mais: you no longer recognise yourselves in a mirror
dilemmes.d74: Your relationship becomes a model everyone admires
dilemmes.d74_mais: you have no privacy left at all
dilemmes.d75_mais: nobody ever talks about the two of you together, always one or the other
dilemmes.d76: Everyone thinks your partner is wonderful
dilemmes.d76_mais: nobody understands what they are doing with you
dilemmes.d77: You adopt the perfect pet, clean and affectionate
dilemmes.d77_mais: it sleeps between the two of you every night
dilemmes.d78_mais: your cat tells you what it really thinks of you
dilemmes.d79: You have a dog that obeys your every command
dilemmes.d79_mais: it only listens to one of you
dilemmes.d80: You can replay one day of your life as a couple
dilemmes.d80_mais: you do not know which one until you wake up inside it
dilemmes.d81: You can put your relationship on pause for a month
dilemmes.d81_mais: your partner will have no memory of that month
dilemmes.d82: You can read the next ten years of your relationship
dilemmes.d82_mais: you can no longer change any of it
dilemmes.d83: You can teleport your partner to your side whenever you want
dilemmes.d83_mais: they can do the same to you, without warning
dilemmes.d84: You can cancel one argument a year
dilemmes.d84_mais: you are the only one who remembers it ever happened
dilemmes.d85: You always know who is in the wrong in an argument
dilemmes.d86: You can make your partner happy with a click of your fingers
dilemmes.d86_mais: you will never know whether it was you or the power that did it
dilemmes.d87: You get free tickets to every concert, for life
dilemmes.d88: You can watch your favourite film for the first time again
dilemmes.d88_mais: you will never be able to watch it again afterwards
dilemmes.d89_mais: you can only ever dance with each other, never with anyone else
dilemmes.d90: You both master a foreign language overnight
dilemmes.d90_mais: you completely forget a language you already spoke
dilemmes.d91: You get unlimited access to every streaming platform
dilemmes.d91_mais: you have to finish everything you start
dilemmes.d92: You never hunt for your keys or your phone again
dilemmes.d92_mais: you lose one sock out of every pair, every time
dilemmes.d93: There is always a parking space right outside your home
dilemmes.d93_mais: it is reserved for your partner's car
dilemmes.d94: Your coffee is perfect every morning
dilemmes.d94_mais: your partner decides what time you wake up
dilemmes.d95: Your feet are never cold at night again
dilemmes.d95_mais: you can never sleep under a duvet again
dilemmes.d96: You know your relationship will last a lifetime
dilemmes.d96_mais: you also know exactly which day you will have argued the most
dilemmes.d97: You live the greatest love story anyone around you has ever seen
dilemmes.d97_mais: nobody will ever know, you have to keep it secret
dilemmes.d98: You can both start over somewhere else, with money in the bank
dilemmes.d98_mais: you cannot tell a single person you are leaving
dilemmes.d99: You pull off the project you have dreamed of together for years
dilemmes.d99_mais: it takes ten years longer than planned
dilemmes.d100: You are certain you are the most important person in your partner's life
dilemmes.d100_mais: they will never say it out loud
